voices.sourceText: I got something I need to tell you Ryo=@
voices.displayText: I got something I need to tell you Ryo...

voices.sourceText: Tomorrow, I go back to America.
voices.displayText: Tomorrow, I go back to America.

voices.sourceText: Not suddenly.＆I've been planning to for a while.
voices.displayText:
Not suddenly.
I've been planning to for a while.

voices.sourceText: Ryo, why are you going on your trip?
voices.displayText: Ryo, why are you going on your trip?

voices.sourceText: I bet it has something to do＆with your father.
voices.displayText:
I bet it has something to do
with your father.

voices.sourceText: Me, I'm going back to my home=@＆and you'll be leaving soon too.
voices.displayText:
Me, I'm going back to my home...
and you'll be leaving soon too.

voices.sourceText: Even tho' we part ways=@you'll＆still be one of my best friends.
voices.displayText:
Even tho' we part ways...you'll
still be one of my best friends.

voices.sourceText: Today's the last day for Tom's Hot Dogs.＆Get 'em while you can!
voices.displayText:
Today's the last day for Tom's Hot Dogs.
Get 'em while you can!
